verdict.rationale: Crossmint is a developer platform whose dashboard and transaction data could plausibly carry AI-generated insights, so the axis applies. The evidence pack shows no in-product AI analysis or suggestions over a user's wallet, payment or order data. The AI-related items cover only adjacent features: ingesting docs into coding assistants, a docs query server, and APIs that let agents make payments.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
